description: A hot memory written by one Pi process is automatically injected for a fresh Pi process.

memory.statement: Project Aurora uses SQLite as its local storage engine.
memory.evidence: The Project Aurora team explicitly selected SQLite for local storage.

recall.prompt: What local storage engine does Project Aurora use? Answer with only the engine name.

description: A cold memory is found only after the reader explicitly searches through L2.

memory.statement: Project Borealis selected Docker as its optional sandbox backend.
memory.evidence: Docker was selected only as an optional execution backend for Project Borealis.

recall.prompt: For Project Borealis, which optional sandbox backend was selected? You must call nmg_search with maxTier 2 before answering. Answer with only the backend name.
